name: Tonemap
description: Compresses the brightness range with a tone-mapping operator (none, linear, gamma, clip, reinhard, hable, mobius).

params.name: tonemap
params.description: Algorithm: 0 none, 1 linear, 2 gamma, 3 clip, 4 reinhard, 5 hable, 6 mobius

params.name: param
params.description: Algorithm parameter; 0 = FFmpeg's default for the algorithm (gamma 1.8, mobius 0.3, others 1). Reinhard: the value p in (0,1] is turned into (1-p)/p

params.name: desat
params.description: Desaturation strength of values brighter than this luma; 0 turns it off
